latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — Quickly edit and export videos with AI-powered processing.

- Upload video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) and describe desired edits; AI handles cutting, transitions, captions, and exports.
- Automatic connection: Sets up authentication and session with a free 7-day token if needed.
- Flexible commands: Supports actions like export, upload, check credits/status, and detailed video edits via chat.
- Fast cloud rendering: 1080p MP4 results typically delivered in 1–2 minutes.
- Robust error handling for tokens, file size/type, credits, and rate limits.
- Designed for content creators seeking quick, polished video outputs without manual tweaking.
